text: APPROVE. The split into `ExpressionAnswersOnlyConstants`, `BlockAnswersOnlyConstants`, `IsForeignStatement` and `IsPayloadCall` preserves every condition and their evaluation order, including the `is ... or ...` pattern precedence and the `k > 0` guard. Each helper has a small cognitive complexity, so the original method should now be well under 15. The new code looks warning-free, with no unused locals and valid doc `paramref`s, but I did not build it, and I could not see the unchanged `statementStart` lines.
